external_physical_refs.text: Phase B design approved by operator on 2026-11-01 in plan run `2026-11-01-7d6d19ce`; no migration has run. [ADR-0075](decisions/ADR-0075-versioned-assertion-semantics-and-admission.md) and the [assembly plan](../features/F0006-assertion-plane-origin-and-interpretation-basis/feature-assembly-plan.md#data-model-and-database-integrity) define exact columns, constraints and migration steps. Existing assertion/evidence identities remain. The only legacy-row addition is a version discriminator defaulting to 1; missing historical quote/mode/release is not reconstructed. New version-2 assertions require one immutable semantic extension, document-scoped reference FKs and server-verified evidence; deferred trigger integrity prevents a core-only v2 record. A review correction of a v2 assertion is a v2 child. It has its own extension, child-owned evidence rows and deterministic correction hashes, and it inherits the original basis. Corrections of v1 rows keep the legacy EXPLICIT basis and stay version 1 (plan run `2026-11-01-512e9303`).

| F0006 | [Assertion semantics and admission](../features/F0006-assertion-plane-origin-and-interpretation-basis/feature-assembly-plan.md) | Phase A+B approved by operator 2026-11-01; F0001–F0005 delivered prerequisites; v1 defaults preserved; no runtime implementation claimed |

No performance SLO, insurance acceptance rule, model accuracy result or production activation is established by this ADR. See the [assembly plan](../../features/F0006-assertion-plane-origin-and-interpretation-basis/feature-assembly-plan.md), [PRD](../../features/F0006-assertion-plane-origin-and-interpretation-basis/PRD.md) and [worked examples](../../features/F0006-assertion-plane-origin-and-interpretation-basis/worked-examples.md).
